result.title: ParetoSaddler: Pareto-Guided Optimization of Agent Harnesses for Quality and Cost
result.comment: Project website and code will be available at https://aka.ms/ParetoSaddler-website
result.summary: Harness optimization can substantially improve LLM agents without modifying model weights, but existing methods primarily optimize response quality. Extending them to joint quality--cost optimization introduces a challenge: applying the deployment preference during intermediate updates can prematurely reject candidates that are valuable for later improvements. We introduce ParetoSaddler, which addresses this mismatch by separating intermediate candidate promotion from final deployment selection. At each iteration, an optimizer updates a parent harness to produce a candidate, and then compares the two over repeated executions and uses Bayesian bootstrap Pareto support to promote candidates showing credible progress in either quality or cost. Promoted candidates receive broader development evaluation and remain available as parents for later optimization steps. We evaluate ParetoSaddler on ClawMark and GAIA2 using domain-disjoint splits. On ClawMark, ParetoSaddler improves quality from 70.86\% to 81.35\% while reducing cost from \$1.17 to \$1.01 per task; on GAIA2, it improves quality from 56.22\% to 62.89\% while reducing cost from \$0.78 to \$0.45 per task. The Pareto-selected harnesses also achieve higher quality at lower cost than quality-only harness optimization. Analysis shows that Pareto-aware optimization retains intermediate candidates that would be discarded by deployment preference but can support later improvements, while Bayesian bootstrap screening filters out candidates whose gains are weakly supported across runs.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ParetoSaddler，在不修改模型权重的前提下迭代优化 LLM agent 的 harness：每轮由父代生成候选，重复执行后用贝叶斯 bootstrap 的 Pareto 支持度筛出在质量或成本任一侧有可信改进的候选予以晋升，把中间候选晋升与最终部署选择分离，从而联合优化质量与成本，并在 ClawMark 与 GAIA2 上报告质量上升、每任务成本下降。
AI.relevance_reason: harness 层面正对应 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益—成本配置，其「中间晋升与部署偏好分离」可能可供核查用于推理轨迹的检查点保留与贡献分配；但对象是 agent 编排搜索而非视觉 latent 推理状态，迁移价值需读原文确认。
